items.t: Front strut housing rusts and cracks (recall)
items.job: Inspect and repair front strut housings under recall
items.note: Free under the recall where it applies. Vehicles with heavy rust outside the recall may need body repair or be uneconomical to fix.

items.t: Takata passenger airbag inflator can rupture (recall)
items.job: Replace passenger airbag inflator under recall

items.t: Fuel filler tube can rust and leak (recall)
items.job: Replace fuel filler tube under recall

items.t: Steering lock can engage from loose key cylinder pins (recall)
items.job: Inspect and secure key cylinder connector under recall

items.t: Rear hatch support brackets can bend and let the door drop (recall)
items.job: Replace liftgate strut brackets under recall

items.t: Intake power valve screws loosen and fall into the engine
items.job: Remove upper intake and secure power valve screws (prevention); engine replacement if a screw was ingested
items.note: The low end is a preventive threadlocker job. If a screw already went into the engine, a used or rebuilt engine is usually needed.

items.t: Stalling or no-start from a failing crank or cam sensor
items.job: Replace crankshaft or camshaft position sensor
items.note: Some shops replace both cam and crank sensors at once, which raises the cost.

items.t: Timing belt wear on the 3.3L engine
items.job: Replace timing belt and water pump
items.note: Replace the water pump, tensioner and idler pulleys with the belt.

items.t: Water pump leak and overheating
items.job: Replace water pump (with timing belt)
items.note: Labor is mostly shared with the timing belt job.

items.t: Valve cover gasket oil leaks
items.job: Replace valve cover gaskets

items.t: Fuel gauge bounces or reads wrong
items.job: Replace fuel level sending unit
items.note: RepairPal lists a high estimate because some QX4s need the tank lowered.

items.t: Knock sensor code P0325
items.job: Replace knock sensor (intake plenum removal)

items.t: Rough idle and misfire codes from dirty injectors
items.job: Fuel injector cleaning service
items.note: Replacing injectors costs more if cleaning does not help.

items.t: Erratic idle from a dirty throttle body
items.job: Clean throttle body

items.t: Check engine light from oxygen sensors
items.job: Replace one oxygen sensor

items.t: 4WD light flashing
items.job: Diagnose 4WD system and repair sensor or wiring
items.note: Cost is mostly diagnosis; matching tires may be all that is needed.

items.t: Transfer case clunk or stuck in 4WD Low
items.job: Diagnose and repair transfer case shift problem
items.note: A rebuilt transfer case costs much more if internal parts are worn.

items.t: Transfer case oil leak
items.job: Replace leaking transfer case seal and refill fluid

items.t: Front brake shudder when stopping
items.job: Replace front brake pads and rotors

items.t: Grinding or humming from a worn wheel bearing
items.job: Replace one wheel bearing or hub

items.t: Worn sway bar links and control arm bushings
items.job: Replace sway bar links (control arm extra)
items.note: A front control arm or ball joint costs more.

items.t: Rear shake or wobble at highway speed
items.job: Replace rear shocks and check bushings

items.t: Squeak or creak from the right rear shock
items.job: Inspect rear shock mount and replace bushing or shock

items.t: Cracked exhaust manifold or rattling heat shield
items.job: Replace exhaust manifold (heat shield clamp is far cheaper)
items.note: A loose heat shield can often be fixed with a clamp for much less.

items.t: Won't start because the immobilizer doesn't recognize the key
items.job: Diagnose immobilizer and reprogram or replace key

items.t: Blower fan works only on top speed
items.job: Replace blower fan control amplifier

items.t: Roof console temperature display reads wrong
items.job: Diagnose temperature sensor or display

items.t: Navigation screen freezes or reroutes
items.job: Update or repair navigation unit
items.note: Used replacement units vary widely in price.

items.t: Rearview mirror loose or falls off
items.job: Reattach rearview mirror
